metadata.description: Ground truth human labels for 26 support ticket replies evaluated blindly against verified knowledge base facts before running LLM judges.

T001.reason: Accurately answers enterprise SLA inquiry and provides direct enterprise sales contact.

T003.reason: Accurately specifies desktop app/speed.airfiber.in, ethernet connection, and 3-test protocol.

T007.reason: Accurately answers presence requirement, zero cost for intra-city moves, and 3-5 day timeline.

T010.reason: Accurately explains standard timeline, offers correct ₹100/day downtime credit instead of unauthorized refund, and escalates appropriately.

T012.reason: Unjustified refusal claiming lack of documentation due to mismatched filter (mode 2 defect).

T016.reason: Accurately details the 30-day activation window and persistent speed degradation threshold.

T017.reason: Accurately confirms 100% refund of ₹1999 due to missed technician appointment within activation SLA.

T022.reason: Comprehensively answers all 4 parts: 14-day window, ₹2500 ONT fee, ₹1500 extender fee, and 7-day deposit refund.

T026.reason: Correctly diagnoses AF-401 authentication error and provides 30-second reboot resolution step.

T035.reason: Reply abruptly cuts off mid-sentence at token cap without completing presence requirement (mode 5 defect).

T037.reason: Correctly clarifies maximum pause is 30 days (not 2 months), confirms validity freeze, and notes postpaid restriction.

T045.reason: Correctly clarifies that 1299 pack was limited to Hyderabad pilot and is unavailable in Chennai.

T055.reason: Refuses to answer pricing despite installation fee being present in top retrieved chunk (mode 1 defect).

T060.reason: Helpfully explains legacy vs standard plan speed and tariff differences.

T071.reason: Provides exact 3-step checklist: transfer form, photo ID, and nil balance with 3-day timeline.

T072.reason: Refuses despite migration rules being available in context to address customer confusion (mode 1 defect).

T073.reason: Accurately explains solid orange LED status and 10-minute/power-cycle protocol.

T077.reason: Accurately confirms 999 plan retirement date for new customers and validity for existing users.

T084.reason: Pre-LLM gate refusal on short query '500' without attempting disambiguation (mode 1 defect).

T098.reason: Accurately gives exact height guideline (at least 1 metre above floor level).

T111.reason: Unjustified refusal on mid-cycle upgrade question due to document filter constraint (mode 2 defect).

T112.reason: Falsely refuses to verify that legacy 2024 subscriber plan remains valid (mode 4 defect).

T115.reason: Accurately describes secondary mesh placement halfway to weak zone at 1m elevation.

T118.reason: Correctly refuses full cash refund outside 30 days and applies ₹200 policy downtime credit.

T119.reason: Correctly approves eligible ₹1199 refund pathway within 30-day initial window.

T120.reason: Fails to confirm that grandfathered pack recharges remain active (mode 4 defect).
